name: nero-chain-docs
description: Agent-facing documentation for NERO Chain (Layer-1 blockchain, native account abstraction, paymaster gas sponsorship). Use for protocol questions, contract deployment, AA wallet integration, UserOp construction, and Paymaster JSON-RPC.

skills.name: Search NERO Chain docs
skills.description: Full-text search across all NERO Chain documentation pages (EN + JA).

skills.name: Get a NERO docs page
skills.description: Fetch the full markdown content of a specific NERO docs page by URL path.

skills.name: List NERO docs sections
skills.description: Get the full navigation tree of NERO Chain documentation.

skills.name: Get Paymaster API method
skills.description: Return the JSON-RPC signature, parameters, and examples for a Paymaster API method (e.g. pm_supported_tokens, pm_sponsor_userop, pm_entrypoints).

skills.name: Get NERO code example
skills.description: Return curated code snippets for common integration tasks (deploy contract, send gasless tx, integrate AA wallet).

skills.name: Get NERO FAQ
skills.description: Return entries from the NERO Chain FAQ, optionally filtered by topic.

authentication.note: Docs are public and unauthenticated. The Paymaster JSON-RPC API at aa-platform.nerochain.io requires an API key obtained via the AA Platform dashboard.

pricing.note: NERO Chain docs access is free. See https://docs.nerochain.io/pricing.md for the gas/paymaster economic model.
